card.title: Cold, Warm, Outside
card.tagline: Apprenez à parler du temps qu'il fait.

song.title: Cold Warm Outside
song.description: Une chanson légère pour parler de la météo du jour.
lyrics: It's cold, it's cold, it's cold outside,
But warm and safe here by your side.
It's cold, it's cold, it's cold outside,
The wind is cold, the fire is warm,
Outside the cold, inside no harm.
Cold outside, but warm we stay,
It's cold, it's cold, it's cold outside,
But warm and safe here by your side.
It's cold, it's cold, it's cold outside,
